description: Source file implementing hash-based message authentication code (HMAC) functions with support for multiple crypto libraries, including OpenSSL, mbedTLS, wolfSSL, Nettle, GnuTLS, and NSS. It defines wrappers for HMAC algorithms like MD5, SHA1, SHA256, and SHA512, and includes conditional compilation based on available crypto backends.
